_README: ⚠️ THIS FILE CANNOT BE REGENERATED IDENTICALLY. DO NOT DELETE IT AS DERIVED DATA. It came from roughly 80 live Wikidata fetches across an eight-round fixpoint closure that resolved 3,725 class items, run on 2026-08-23. Wikidata has moved since. Re-running the fetch would produce a different model, and every count in ingredient_cuts.py and every threshold measured against it would shift. It is an INPUT to build_library.py, not an output of it.
_what: Supertype plus subtypes for each of the 28,630 Wikidata items under food (Q2095). Per item: kinds (the assignment and its hop distance), via (which anchor class reached each kind), props, third_hop, generic_depth.
_how: Nearest-anchor breadth-first walk up P279 with a two-hop cap, specific anchors tried before a generic food fallback. A full transitive closure was tried first and collapsed the grouping to 97.5% 'Brand or trademark', which is why the cap exists.
_caveat: ⚠️ 'Cultivar or plant variety' matched ZERO of the 28,630 items, so the cultivar exclusion never fired and roughly 1,176 cultivars entered the library under the strongest rule. That hole is real and is not fixed here.
